description: This Java class defines the ProgramAttributeType entity, representing a database table 'program_attribute_type' and extending BaseAttributeType with specific type parameters. It includes Hibernate annotations for ORM mapping, getters, and setters for its primary key. This class is part of the OpenMRS project, used to model attribute types associated with programs.
